claim_1.claim: ELISA analysis of serum from 30 healthy young adults (MCV4, n=17; MPSV4, n=13) over more than 2 years post-vaccination showed polysaccharide-specific total IgG binding antibody responses against serogroups A and C in MCV4 vaccinees compared to baseline.

sources.quote: Both vaccines induced robust polysaccharide-specific IgG binding antibody responses against serogroups A and C, as measured by ELISA.

Figure 1 Antibody responses of meningococcal vaccinees. Serogroups A and C were measured for total IgG (a), IgG1 and IgG2 (b), IgM (c) and SBA titers (d). (e) A strong IgG response against diphtheria toxoid was detected in MCV4 vaccinees. (f) Antibody secreting cells (ASCs, selected as CD3− CD20− CD38hi CD27hi CD19+ cells) and (g) the number of ASCs at day 7 correlated with diphtheria toxoid-specific serum IgG at day 7. * p<0.05, ** p<0.01, *** p<0.001; unpaired t-test was used for comparisons between vaccine groups, paired t-test was used for comparisons to baseline within a group, Pearson’s correlation was used in (g). All plots show mean values (n=13 for MPSV4 and n=17 for MCV4) from one experiment, error bars as s.e.m.
